description: Diagnosis dashboard for the aisbench prefix_cache scaling test (input_len=16384, output_len=512, repeat_rate=90%%). As concurrency==prefix_num piles up, TPS saturates then declines (identical with/without UCM). Reads vLLM + UCM metrics to prove whether the cause is HBM KV capacity/preemption, prefix hit-rate erosion, scheduler-side prefix-lookup cost, or UCM reload-path saturation.

panels.title: A. Measured bottleneck: throughput and latency
panels.description: TPS here = output (generation) tokens/s. If throughput plateaus then declines while concurrency == prefix_num piles up, look at B/C for why (cache pressure + hit-rate erosion).

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum(rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Total Token Throughput (TPS)
panels.description: aisbench-reported TPS decline should be reproduced here. Prompt TPS rising faster than Generation TPS => more prefill/recompute per request.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum(rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Request Latency Percentiles (e2e)
panels.description: E2E latency climbs with concurrency; P99 grows fastest when requests wait for cache/GPU resources.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum(rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Time to First Token (TTFT)
panels.description: Rising TTFT => prefill queueing/recompute growing; the 14.7K-token prefix must be recomputed or reloaded whenever it is not in cache.

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:request_prefill_time_seconds_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(vllm:request_decode_time_seconds_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Prefill vs Decode Time Share (fraction of wall time)
panels.description: If prefill time share rises while decode time share stagnates, GPU is being spent re-doing shared prefix prefill instead of generating new tokens => direct cause of TPS decline.

panels.title: B. KV cache pressure: why throughput stops scaling
panels.description: prefix working set = prefix_num * ~14.7K tokens + concurrency * 512 output tokens. When it exceeds HBM KV capacity the scheduler cannot allocate blocks (scheduler.py allocate_slots returns None) and preempts requests, which resets num_computed_tokens=0 and forces full 16K-token recompute.

targets.expr: max(vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})

panels.title: KV Cache Usage (saturation)
panels.description: Should pin near 1.0 at the bottleneck: HBM KV capacity is the hard resource limit.

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:num_preemptions_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Preemptions per Second (recompute waste)
panels.description: Smoking gun. Each preemption discards the computed KV of a running request; with 16K prompts, resuming means re-prefilling the whole prompt (or re-loading it). A spike as prefix_num/concurrency grows proves capacity-driven thrashing.

targets.expr: sum(vllm:num_requests_running{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})
sum(vllm:num_requests_waiting{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})

panels.title: Scheduler State
panels.description: Waiting > 0 with running pinned => requests queued behind the block/cache limit, not because there is no GPU time.

targets.expr: 1 / clamp_min(sum(rate(vllm:iteration_tokens_total_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Engine Step Time (s)  [scheduler cadence]
panels.description: 1 / steps-per-second. Rising step time with concurrency while tokens/step (next panel) stays flat => per-step overhead (scheduler loop, prefix lookup, UCM connector calls) is the limiter, identical with/without UCM.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:iteration_tokens_total_bucket{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Tokens per Engine Step (median effective batch)
panels.description: Compare with step time. If tokens/step stops growing while step time keeps growing, the extra wall time is overhead, not useful work.

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:request_max_num_generation_tokens_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Max Generation Tokens (seq budget)
panels.description: Sanity check that request shape (output_len=512) is constant across runs; any throughput delta is then workload-vs-cache, not request-shape, driven.

panels.title: C. Prefix hit-rate erosion (HBM vs UCM)
panels.description: Nominal repeat rate is 90%. If HBM hit rate falls as prefix_num grows (LRU evicting prefix blocks before round-robin reuse), prefill work grows. The UCM columns show whether the external cache actually recovered the evicted prefixes.

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: HBM Prefix Cache Hit Rate
panels.description: Fall below ~0.9 as prefix_num grows => eviction is eroding the nominal 90% reuse.

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:external_prefix_cache_hits_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(vllm:external_prefix_cache_queries_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

(sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)) + ((sum(rate(vllm:external_prefix_cache_hits_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(vllm:external_prefix_cache_queries_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)) * clamp_min(1 - (sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)), 0))

panels.title: UCM External Prefix Cache Hit Rate
panels.description: If external hit rate ~0 while HBM hit rate is falling, UCM is NOT recovering the evicted prefixes -> it cannot prevent the recompute cost, which is why TPS is identical with and without UCM.

targets.expr: sum(rate(ucm:total_prefix_query_tokens_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(ucm:gpu_hbm_hit_tokens_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(ucm:ucm_hit_tokens_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

clamp_min(sum(rate(ucm:total_prefix_query_tokens_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum(rate(ucm:gpu_hbm_hit_tokens_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum(rate(ucm:ucm_hit_tokens_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])), 0)

panels.title: UCM Connector Token Query Breakdown (rate)
panels.description: Tokenizer-level attribution from the UCM connector. 'Missed' tokens must be recomputed on GPU; its growth is the direct prefill work increase.

targets.expr: sum(rate(ucm:cache_lookup_hit_blocks_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(ucm:cache_lookup_miss_blocks_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum(rate(ucm:cache_lookup_hit_blocks_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(ucm:cache_lookup_hit_blocks_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(ucm:cache_lookup_miss_blocks_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: UCM Cache Lookup Hit / Miss (block level)
panels.description: Block-level view of the Cache-stage lookup. Rising misses => UCM cannot serve the reused prefix from its in-memory buffer and must descend to the backend.

panels.title: D. UCM reload path: can it keep up?
panels.description: Even if UCM holds the prefix externally, reloading a 14.7K-token prefix must beat GPU recompute and HBM reload bandwidth. These panels show the load pipeline's throughput and latency, and whether it is saturated/queueing.

targets.expr: sum(rate(ucm:cache_load_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(ucm:cache_dump_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cache Load / Dump Task Rate
panels.description: Task throughput of the Cache stage. If load task rate plateaus while miss tokens grow (panel C), reload bandwidth is the ceiling.

targets.expr: sum(rate(ucm:cache_load_bytes_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e9
sum(rate(ucm:cache_dump_bytes_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e9

panels.title: Cache Load Bandwidth (aggregated GB/s)
panels.description: Actual sustained bytes/s through the Cache stage. A 14.7K-token prefix of a large model is tens of MB; compare reload bandwidth to the miss rate to see if HBM can be re-filled in time.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(ucm:cache_load_duration_ms_bucket{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(ucm:cache_load_duration_ms_bucket{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum(rate(ucm:cache_load_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(ucm:cache_load_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Cache Load Total Duration (ms)
panels.description: End-to-end load task latency. If P99 grows with prefix_num, reloads take longer than recompute, so UCM can't improve TPS.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(ucm:cache_load_queue_wait_duration_ms_bucket{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))
sum(rate(ucm:cache_load_queue_full_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(ucm:cache_dump_queue_full_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cache Load Queue Wait (ms) & Queue-Full Rejections
panels.description: Queueing in the load pipeline => reload demand exceeds dispatcher capacity; queue-full rejections mean requests fall back to recompute.

targets.expr: sum(rate(ucm:cache_load_wait_shards_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(ucm:cache_load_shards_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Cache Load Wait-Shard Ratio
panels.description: Fraction of load shards whose Cache buffer was not ready and had to wait. Near 1.0 => the cache buffer / backend is the bottleneck on every reload.

targets.expr: sum(rate(ucm:cache_load_backend_shards_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(ucm:cache_load_success_shards_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(ucm:cache_load_failed_shards_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cache Load Backend Descend Rate
panels.description: How many load shards truly had to go to the lower tier (cache-buffer miss) and whether they complete or fail.

panels.title: E. UCM cost inside the vLLM scheduler critical path
panels.description: With UCM enabled, every newly admitted request calls connector.get_num_new_matched_tokens() in the scheduler loop, and evicted prefixes go through start_load_kv / wait_for_layer_load. If these grow with concurrency/prefix_num, UCM adds per-request CPU latency that explains 'the same as without UCM' (or worse).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(ucm:connector_get_num_new_matched_tokens_duration_ms_bucket{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(ucm:connector_get_num_new_matched_tokens_duration_ms_bucket{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Connector get_num_new_matched_tokens (ms)
panels.description: Per-request external prefix lookup duration, executed synchronously in the scheduler. Scales with prompt length (16384 tokens) and number of matched blocks.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(ucm:connector_start_load_kv_duration_ms_bucket{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(ucm:connector_wait_for_layer_load_duration_ms_bucket{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Connector Load Path (ms): start_load_kv / wait_for_layer_load
panels.description: Scheduler/worker time spent initiating and waiting for KV reload. Large values mean the GPU is stalled on UCM reload instead of generating tokens.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(ucm:connector_save_kv_layer_duration_ms_bucket{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(ucm:connector_wait_for_save_duration_ms_bucket{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Connector Dump Path (ms): save_kv_layer / wait_for_save
panels.description: Cost of saving computed prefixes into UCM. If prefixes must be re-saved on every recompute (because they were evicted), dump traffic grows with prefix_num.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(ucm:cache_lookup_duration_ms_bucket{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(ucm:cache_lookup_backend_duration_ms_bucket{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Cache Lookup & Backend Lookup Duration (ms)
panels.description: Cache-stage lookup latency. Backend lookup grows when the in-memory Cache buffer misses and the request descends to Posix/YuanRong.

list.name: worker_rank

query.query: label_values({__name__=~"ucm:.*", job=~"$job", model_name="$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}, worker_rank)

title: vLLM TPS Bottleneck (prefix_cache scaling)
